title: Hidden evaluation run during the Q course

tellings.quote: it was an evaluation for another unit in the military above you know these units

plain: Randy Anderson, a former soldier who says he saw alien technology at a military base, says the Special Forces Qualification Course was more than it seemed. That course is the US Army's selection and training course for its Special Forces. He says that while he was going through it, the course was also secretly used to assess soldiers for another military unit ranked above those units. He tells it as someone who went through it, and it would mean some recruits were being quietly picked for a more secret outfit.
